about: Alyson F. Lembeck is a top-rated attorney practicing in the Atlanta, Georgia area. Providing legal representation in Georgia for a variety of different issues, Alyson Lembeck was selected to Super Lawyers for 2019 - 2027.

After completing undergraduate studies, Alyson F. Lembeck attended law school. Alyson Lembeck was enrolled at Emory University School of Law. She earned a juris doctor degree in 2002. Alyson Lembeck was admitted to the practice of law in 2002.

Attorneys like Alyson F. Lembeck are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.
Alyson Lembeck represents clients with Family Law issues.
